title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks

title: China's August retail sales miss forecast while investment slump deepens, piling pressure on Beijing

title: Bank of America expects third-quarter investment banking fees to fall more than 10%; shares slide

title: Prediction market traders think gas prices will hit new highs for the year

title: NFL and midterm elections set up prediction markets for a critical fall season

title: Prediction markets are becoming more professionalized, but also harder to beat
snippet: The institutionalization of prediction markets threatens to erode the edge of skilled traders who earn off mispricing and market inefficiencies, experts say.

title: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks

title: OpenAI targets work of Wall Street junior bankers with new ChatGPT for Financial Services

title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
